transcript.msg: What led you to send this to enhanced review? And what would have changed your mind?
The largest owner holds 35% and isn't verified. Anything over 25% that isn't verified goes to enhanced review.
If the country risk were "high" instead of medium, what would you decide?
No, the country doesn't drive this one. It's the unverified owner holding 35%.
What told you to approve onboarding here, and what would have changed your mind?
They've banked with us for three years, and their source of funds is verified, so the high-risk country on its own doesn't send them to enhanced review.
If the analyst risk rating were "medium" instead of high, what would you decide?
They've banked with us for three years, and their source of funds is verified, so the high-risk country on its own doesn't send them to enhanced review.
What pushed you to escalate to the compliance officer here, and what would have changed your mind?
She's a politically exposed person, so it goes to the compliance officer, whatever else the file says.
